messages:
janet_sales: Quick blocker: Centrica POC wants to sign MSA + orderform today. They sent a redline and require SCCs, a PO field on the orderform, tenant-isolated key attestation, and a 30-day deletion SLA. Any quick triage?

mike_legal: Share the redline. 30-day deletion is usually a no for backups. We should offer 30 days for customer data + 90 days for backups. Also need to review any indemnity/limitation edits.

janet_sales: Uploaded Centrica_Redline_0426.pdf. They also changed payment to net60 and added a requirement to list subprocessors in the orderform.

ron_procure: We can add PO number + billing block + vendor tax ID. Finance prefers net30; net60 needs approval. I can escalate. Subprocessor list we usually attach as schedule, not the orderform.

lee_sre: For KMS attestation: we can provide factual language that keys are logically isolated and managed by [Cloud KMS]. We do not provide tenant HSMs on hosted. If they insist on per-tenant HSM, we need Private deployment + pricing.

mike_legal: Draft attestation: "Redwood confirms that in the hosted service, encryption keys are logically isolated per customer, managed via [Cloud KMS], and stored encrypted. This attestation is informational and does not expand liability under the MSA." Paste and use as a factual addendum.

janet_sales: Sending that attestation now. Can procurement confirm if PO field + subprocessor schedule attachment is okay as a compromise?

ron_procure: Yes. We'll include a checkbox on the orderform referencing the subprocessor schedule URL and include invoice-to/remit-to blocks. I'll set payment terms to net30 pending finance approval for net60.

centrica (via janet_sales): They replied: net60 is a hard requirement for AP. Can Redwood accept net60 for pilot? Also asked to initial any MSA redlines.

mike_legal: If net60 is required, we need finance sign-off. Also ask Centrica to initial the MSA redline to speed things up. We'll counter on deletion windows to 30/90 split and 30 days' notice for subprocessor changes.

ron_procure: Escalating to finance now and cc'ing @finance on the thread. If approved, we can set net60 for this customer.

sign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: "Redwood  Centrica POC - MSA + Orderform" (env: c9d8e7f6). Recipients: centrica_signer, janet_sales.

janet_sales: Sent to Centrica and asked them to initial redline. Also asked if provisional PO (PO number to be added after finance issues) is acceptable for their AP flow while we process approval.

centrica: They viewed and said provisional PO isn't allowed; PO must be on signed orderform. They will initial today if net60 is accepted.

ron_procure: Finance approved net60 for pilot deals with expected ARR > $120k; please confirm deal funnel size so I can formally set terms.

janet_sales: Estimated ARR ~140k if converted. Marking for net60. Thanks!

mike_legal: Final: sending redline with 30/90 deletion split, KMS attestation language, 30-day notice for subprocessors, SCCs accepted as-is subject to carveouts. Ask them to initial and sign.

sign-bot: Envelope viewed by centrica_signer at 1841234578.

lee_sre: I'll prep SOC2 redacted and current subprocessor schedule in case they ask. Turnaround 1 business day for questionnaire responses.

sign-bot: Envelope completed at 1841234589. Signed MSA and orderform uploaded to deals/Centrica/2026/attachments.

janet_sales: Awesome  attaching signed docs to CRM and routing to finance for PO issuance. Great coordination, team. :tada:
